title: Countries with both
statementMd:
List countries that have both an airline and an airport.

Expected columns: `country`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT country FROM airlines INTERSECT SELECT country FROM airports;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
